text:
maria: heads-up: scheduling a config-only rollout tonight 23:45 UTC. scope: prod global (staged). changes: token_shaper.max_share 0.9 -> 0.78, concurrency_limit.worker 72 -> 48, default_batch_items 18 -> 9, api_request_timeout_ms 13000 -> 9500. we'll pin routing policy to 'latency-first' for the rollout window. canary: asia-southeast1 for 20m.

tom: got it. what's the explicit rollback criteria?

maria: rollback if p99 > baseline *1.25 for 15m OR 5xx rate >0.35% sustained 10m. also abort if any host kvcache_evictions/min >220 or sustained token/sec drop >30% for 5m.

devops-lee: i'll add synthetic probes for top long-seq routes and a draft dashboard with p95/p99, 5xx, evicts, inflight. also recommend kv_warm_ms=11000 on canary for 6m.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] cfg-2026-06-05-001 (config-only) -> canary(asia-southeast1) at 1765433580

sre-zoe: preflight: redwoodctl config preview --env prod --file cfg-2026-06-05-001.json and run smoke harness. i'll wire alerts to oncall.

maria: applied canary payload to staging earlier; saw p99 down slightly on short seqs, but long-seq throughput dipped ~12%.

deploy-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-06-05-001 -> asia-southeast1 at 1765433610

sre-zoe: 8m snapshot: p95 195ms (base 185ms), p99 710ms (base 690ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alarms yet.

tom: recommend slow ramp: 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with manual gates. ops-marc ok?

ops-marc: agree. manual sign-off at each gate. hold traffic steering for 25m after canary.

maria: release note draft for announcements:

Config-only tuning (no model changes):
- token_shaper.max_share: 0.90 -> 0.78 (tighter share during bursts)
- concurrency_limit.worker: 72 -> 48
- default_batch_items: 18 -> 9 (reduce latency variance)
- api_request_timeout_ms: 13000 -> 9500
- routing pinned to 'latency-first' for rollout

Note: TTL warmup applied to canary nodes. Per-route overrides are supported for heavy long-sequence tenants.

deploy-bot: [rollout] staged -> 3% at 1765433700

sre-zoe: alert: kvcache evictions spike on a subset of eu-west hosts at 1765433745 correlated with tenant-gamma. p99 on those hosts climbed to 1.7s.

tom: pause ramp. ops-marc hold further increases.

ops-marc: paused. setting routing fallback for eu-west to previous weighting.

devops-lee: initial analysis: tenant-gamma runs long sequences and steady high token/s; reducing batch_items increased kv churn for them. propose per-route override: tenant-gamma.batch_items=18 and tenant-gamma.concurrency_limit=80.

maria: prepare hotfix. we'll apply per-route exception for tenant-gamma in eu-west and observe for 10m before deciding.

deploy-bot: [hotfix queued] per-route override tenant-gamma -> will apply to eu-west at 1765433765

sre-zoe: hotfix applied. eu-west p99 dropped to 730ms, 5xx back to baseline.

tom: after hotfix, metrics look stable. suggestion: do not rollback globally; keep global config but add per-route exceptions for identified long-seq tenants. update runbook to list per-route override as primary mitigation for kv churn.

maria: agreed. resuming rollout: continue from 3% -> 15% after 10m hold. tagging config as cfg-2026-06-05-001. I'll update release notes to include per-route exception details.

deploy-bot: [rollout resumed] -> 15% at 1765433780

sre-zoe: monitoring: stable at 15% for 7m, no alerts.

ops-marc: proceed to 40% in 20m if no regressions. manual sign-off required.

maria: finalizing announcement copy and post-rollout checklist. we'll publish full notes once at 100% + 30m healthy. thanks all.
